Package com.microservices.reservation.products.services

Class ProductServiceManagement

java.lang.Object
com.microservices.reservation.products.services.ProductServiceManagement
@Service public class ProductServiceManagement extends Object
Service class responsible for managing product-related operations. Handles the addition of products and retrieval of products by reservation.

  • Method Details

    • add

      @Transactional(rollbackFor=java.lang.Exception.class) public List<ProductResponse> add(UUID uid, List<ProductRequest> products)
      Adds a list of products to a reservation. For each product request, fetches the corresponding product type and reservation, then maps and persists the product entity.
      Parameters:
      uid - The UUID of the reservation to which products will be added.
      products - A list of ProductRequest objects representing the products to be added.
      Returns:
      A list of ProductResponse objects representing the added products.
      Since:
      1.0

    • findProductsByReservation

      public org.springframework.data.domain.Page<ProductResponse> findProductsByReservation(UUID uid, org.springframework.data.domain.Pageable pageable)
      Retrieves products associated with a specific reservation.
      Parameters:
      uid - The UUID of the reservation for which products are to be retrieved.
      pageable - The Pageable object specifying pagination information.
      Returns:
      A Page of ProductResponse objects representing the products for the reservation.
      Since:
      1.0
